1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea perenne de hasta 3 m de altura, de hojas grandes y oblongas, flores grandes y vistosas, de color rojo, naranja o amarillo, fruto en cápsula, de color castaño, con semillas negras y muy duras. Cannaceae Canna indica.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herbaceous plant reaching up to 3 m in height, with large and oblong leaves, large and showy flowers of red, orange or yellow color, fruit in capsule, brown in color, with black and very hard seeds. Cannaceae Canna indica.
